meta.name: ecommerce-full-pipeline
meta.description: 电商运营在开展跨境电商或闲鱼捡漏业务时，若需解决选品难、上架繁琐等痛点，必用此技能！一键打通“爆品挖掘→1688采集→多平台上架→推广文案→短视频生成”全自动流水线，轻松实现端到端自动化，让开店运营效率翻倍。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动完成从爆品挖掘到上架推广的电商全流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你在做跨境电商或闲鱼捡漏，想省掉选品上架的繁琐
copy.tagline_en: Automate the full ecommerce flow from product discovery to listing and promotion
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you do cross-border or Xianyu sales and want to skip manual listing.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会调用一个 Python 命令行工具：从 1688 采集商品并清洗数据、生成微信小店/Shopify/TikTok 上架模板和推广文案、用商品图片合成竖屏短视频，还能搜闲鱼比价捡漏、按地址代发下单。
howto.when: 当你要做跨境电商的选品、上架、推广等环节，或想在闲鱼捡漏选品时，它会接管。

say.text: 用 auto-pipeline 挖掘收纳盒、蓝牙耳机的爆品并生成上架模板
say.note: 会依次跑挖掘、采集、清洗、上架、推广和视频

say.text: 采集蓝牙耳机 2 页商品详情和图片，清洗后导出
say.note: 低于毛利率 20%、评分 60 的商品会被过滤

say.text: 在闲鱼按 999 元预算搜 4K 云台投影仪，帮我捡漏
say.note: 按六维评分排序并标出虚标风险

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude drives a Python CLI: it scrapes 1688 products, cleans the data, generates listing templates for WeChat Store, Shopify and TikTok plus ad copy, turns product images into short vertical videos, and hunts Xianyu bargains.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you need cross-border e-commerce work such as product picking, listing or promotion, or want Xianyu bargain hunting.

say_en.text: Run auto-pipeline on storage boxes and Bluetooth earphones, then make listing templates
say_en.note: Runs discovery, scraping, cleaning, listing, promo and video

say_en.text: Scrape 2 pages of Bluetooth earphone details and images, then clean them
say_en.note: Drops items under 20% margin or 60 supplier score

say_en.text: Hunt Xianyu for a 4K gimbal projector under 999
say_en.note: Ranks by six-dimension score and flags fake specs
